title: Integrations
lead: The services this app works with: your media library, the sources it searches for releases, your download clients, and a metadata catalog (TMDb) that feeds the Recommendations page.
unknownType: This version of the app can't connect to “{{type}}”. You can only remove this integration.
actionFailed: Could not change this integration. Reload the page and try again.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded integrations.
empty: No integrations yet. Click Add integration to connect Jellyfin, a Torznab source such as Prowlarr or Jackett, a download client such as qBittorrent or Transmission, or a metadata catalog (TMDb) that feeds the Recommendations page.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: The app forgets {{name}}, its stored credentials and its path mappings. Nothing changes in the service itself. This can't be undone.
remove.messageLibrary: The app forgets {{name}}, its stored credentials and its path mappings, and removes the library it imported: its movies, series, versions and files leave the Library page for everyone. Your files and {{service}} itself are not touched. This can't be undone.
remove.messageDownloadClient: The app forgets {{name}}, its stored credentials and its path mappings, and removes every destination that uses it, including the default destination if it is one of them. Their categories stay in {{service}}, and {{service}} itself is not touched. This can't be undone.
remove.messageDownloadClientFolder: The app forgets {{name}}, its stored credentials and its path mappings, and removes every destination that uses it, including the default destination if it is one of them. Nothing changes in {{service}}: torrents already sent keep their folder and label. This can't be undone.

dialog.createDescription: Connect a service. You can test the connection before you save it.
dialog.editDescription: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave a field empty to keep what is stored.
dialog.typesFailed: Could not load the services this app can connect to.
dialog.serviceFixed: The service can't be changed. To connect another one, add a new integration.
dialog.name: Name

addressHelp.generic: The address the service answers at, starting with http:// or https://.
addressHelp.jellyfin: Jellyfin's address, with its base path if it has one, such as http://192.168.1.10:8096.
addressHelp.torznab: The feed's Torznab address. Prowlarr shows it in the indexer's details, such as http://192.168.1.10:9696/1/api; Jackett's Copy Torznab Feed gives one such as http://192.168.1.10:9117/api/v2.0/indexers/toloka/results/torznab/.
addressHelp.qbittorrent: The address of qBittorrent's Web UI, such as http://192.168.1.10:8080.
addressHelp.transmission: The address of Transmission's web interface, such as http://192.168.1.10:9091. Transmission 4.0 or newer.
addressHelp.tmdb: TMDb's API address, https://api.themoviedb.org. In the API key field, enter TMDb's API Read Access Token from themoviedb.org → Settings → API, not the shorter API key.

dialog.tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
dialog.catalogLanguageHint: Titles, overviews and posters on the Recommendations page and in the TMDb link dialog come in this language where TMDb has them, otherwise in the original. The release sources are searched by these titles too, so pick the language your trackers name films in. After a change, the app reads the catalog again at its next computation.
dialog.secretStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
dialog.enabledHint: Switched off, the app keeps the settings but leaves the service alone.

mappings.title: Path mappings
mappings.help: If {{service}} sees your media under other paths than this app does, map each of its folders to this app's, for example /downloads → /media.
mappings.helpFolder: Your library folders become {{service}}'s destinations through these mappings: map each folder {{service}} sees to this app's, for example /downloads → /media.
mappings.none: No mappings: {{service}} sees your media at the same paths as this app.
